subject: ⚠️ Disk Space Warning: {{usagePercent}}% used
title: Disk Space Warning
disk_scope: This figure is for the disk that holds the backup directory, which on a default install is the server's main disk. Anything stored on that disk could be what is filling it, for example backups, container images, the database or uploaded media.
first_step: First, find out what is taking the space: on the server, run docker system df and df -h (or ask whoever runs the server to run them). If they show that container images take up most of the space, running bin/deploy.sh upgrades to the configured version and then removes older application images. If you pin PAVILLION_IMAGE_TAG, or the disk is too full to download a new image, see the guide.
guide_link_text: Guide: when the disk alert arrives
action_expand_storage: If what fills the disk is data you need to keep, expand the server's storage.
footer_note: This alert was triggered because disk usage exceeded {{threshold}}%. You will receive a critical alert at 90% usage.
footer_text: This is an automated alert. Disk space is monitored hourly.
